arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two players, frozen routed-v6 direct opponent, 2400-action finite horizon

cached_vs_fresh_same_state_actions.interpretation: At the first action of each root turn, a fresh fork exactly reproduced the cached teacher. After the first action, more than a quarter of cached actions differed from a fresh three-turn search on the identical game state and legal-action indexing. The cached agent retains a whole-turn plan that is not available to the feedforward student observation. This is a real target-definition boundary, not proof it caused previous student losses.

interpretation: Fresh replanning is a deterministic observation-state teacher and looked promising against the direct model in this small pilot, but its apparent seat0 gain and cached-versus-replanned difference require disjoint confirmation. It performs more native searches per root turn and is not a low-cost student or a new rated agent. Replan's game outcome does not establish why earlier imitation students failed.
next_decision: Predeclare a fresh both-seat 64-map confirmation of cached, replanned and direct complete games with explicit censoring and map grouping. If fresh replanning fails to beat direct or regresses a seat, do not adopt it as a new teacher. If it passes, separately design a state-observation imitation target on new disjoint fit/validation/game maps; do not train on this pilot.
